## Framing

Each painting's page says whether it comes framed. Placeholder: frame styles, and framing on request.

## Caring for your painting

Hang it out of direct sunlight, away from radiators and damp. Dust it gently with a soft, dry brush.

## Returns

If a print isn't right, you can return it within 14 days of delivery for a refund. Placeholder: Cali to confirm the terms.

## Paying

Payments are taken securely by Stripe, by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. I never see your card details.

## Your details

I only use your name and address to send your order, and your email to tell you about it. I count visits to the site with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which uses no cookies and doesn't track you from site to site. Placeholder: Cali to confirm, and add anything about the Studio Letter.

## Something else?

[Send me a message](/contact/) and I'll get back to you.
